findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed from a concrete `DetectorHandler` (with a stub `evaluate`) to `class MetricAlertDetectorHandler(StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate]): pass`. `StatefulDetectorHandler` declares four abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`), none of which are implemented here. Because `Detector.detector_handler` does `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, any `Detector` whose `type` is `metric_alert_fire` will now raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class` inside `process_detectors`, instead of the previous behaviour of returning no results. Either keep a concrete stub implementation of the abstract methods or do not point `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` at an abstract class until it is implemented.

findings.title: Expected occurrence built with wrong group key in TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe
findings.body: In `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe` the expected `IssueOccurrence` is built with `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, PriorityLevel.HIGH)`, but `evaluate_group_key_value` is invoked with group key `"group_key"`. The handler's `build_occurrence_and_event_data` will therefore produce a fingerprint `["<id>:group_key"]` while the expected occurrence has `["<id>:val1"]`. Since `IssueOccurrence` is a frozen dataclass compared field-by-field, this equality assertion either fails outright or, if it passes, indicates the comparison is not actually verifying the produced occurrence. The mock should be built with `expected_result.group_key` ("group_key").

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` now returns `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]` keyed by group key, but its docstring still states "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". Implementers reading the docstring will get the wrong contract; update it to describe the dict keyed by group key.
